observation.visible_scene: A person with a top-knot hairstyle and white t-shirt sits behind a dark tray, holding a stainless-steel gooseneck kettle raised and tilted in their right hand so its spout hovers over a black conical pour-over dripper. The dripper rests on a glass server placed on a small scale. To the left on the tray is a glass of dark brewed coffee with a light foam head; to the right is a copper-colored cup. A black microphone edge intrudes at the left frame border against a plain beige wall. The person's mouth is open in most frames, indicating they are talking while maintaining the pouring posture.
visible_changes: The person's mouth repeatedly opens and closes and changes shape across the frames, consistent with continuous speech.
The person's eyes look downward toward the dripper and intermittently close (blinking), with small shifts in head tilt.
The kettle is held in a nearly constant tilted pouring position over the dripper throughout the excerpt; no large repositioning or lifting away is seen.
The coffee bed/foam in the dripper and the liquid level in the server remain visually stable, with no obvious change in volume.
The background, tray objects (glass, copper cup, scale), and microphone stay fixed in position, indicating a static camera with no pan or zoom.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the pour began before this segment or continues after it is not shown.
The content of the person's speech is not available.
The final amount of water poured or the brew outcome is outside the clip.
uncertain_details: A thin water stream from the spout into the dripper is hard to confirm at this resolution; the kettle is clearly in a pouring pose but the stream itself is faint.
Any slight change in server fill level is too small to verify reliably frame to frame.
